items.summary: Recommendation: do not add spend, new capability, or new implementation this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with 57 improvements measuring, 21 failed requests, and 108 approved proposals without execution. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission in an aggregate provider row that cannot be assigned to a site. Site-attributed income is $0, so revenue, contribution margin, ROI, and causal lift are not supportable. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA work as a measurement-only candidate after capacity clears; its baseline is 61 clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission. Do not forecast upside or treat clicks, sessions, impressions, conversions, or opportunity scores as revenue.

AI usage on 2026-10-01 is $2.2785467 across 16 calls and four instrumented sites; the arithmetic cost per call is approximately $0.1424, but cost-to-learn is not calculable because no measured learning outcome, incremental revenue, or controlled experiment result is available. Infrastructure, hosting, domain, labor, and marketing costs are not present; monthly fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue target, and revenue floor are blank. Contribution margin therefore cannot be calculated. Minimum measurement: a dated cost ledger by site and work item covering AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, and marketing costs, joined to site-attributed shipped commission or other verified revenue, plus experiment exposure and outcome identifiers. Use existing read-only telemetry only; do not move money or request duplicate telemetry.
